title: Include License Text
description: Include the full license text for MIT, BSD, Apache, etc. so that we are fully compliant. Clicking on the license chip should show it as a dialog overlay (scrollable if needed for longer licenses) or something that includes the text and not just the name.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by making `/about` license badges interactive and opening a scrollable in-page dialog overlay with full standard text for MIT, Apache-2.0, and BSD-2-Clause license families. Added route-smoke coverage for MIT and BSD-2-Clause disclosure, plus an interactivity-aware dependency-search helper for Blazor prerender timing. Evidence: `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/About.razor`, `MemorySmith.App/wwwroot/app.css`, `e2e/tests/route-smoke.spec.ts`. Validation passed: `dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo`; focused About route-smoke 1/1; full route-smoke 6/6 against `http://127.0.0.1:5099`.
